# 1800. Maximum Ascending Subarray Sum

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def maxAscendingSum(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = nums[0]
        cur_sum = nums[0]
        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            if nums[i] > nums[i - 1]:
                cur_sum += nums[i]
            else:
                cur_sum = nums[i]
            ans = max(ans, cur_sum)
        return ans
```
